To Shipper:

This container release letter is VALID ONLY FOR 04 DAY/S from the date of issue on the container release letter and thereafter Line Detention will be applicable as per the Line tariff. Any cancellation of the export booking has to be intimated to us in writing within the validity period or applicable charges will be collected at the time of returning the container.

1. The IFRAZ copy must be submitted to the line (once available) to avoid any shut out to the container (s). If the copy is not provided before the cutoff then container (s) will be shut out by the port and we; As agents will not be responsible for and consequences that may arise from it. All related charges will be on Shipper’s / Booking Party’s account.

2. Gross weight of cargo should not to exceed the weight limitation mentioned on the container’s CSC plate. Full containers exceeding the weight limits will not be loaded and all consequential costs relating to it (ie/ Shifting, cross stuffing, Port storage, line detention etc.) will be to shippers account. Shipper will also be responsible for fines, claims and damages arising out of non/wrong declaration of cargo/container weights.

3. The free storage period for Export full containers under the current MWANI Qatar port tariff (2ND Amendment February 2020) has been increased to 10 days. Thereafter QR 75/20’ & QR 150/40’ per day will be charged for next 5 days under the 1st slab. Then thereafter QR 150/20’ and QR 300/40’ per day will be charged under the 2nd slab until the container is exported.

4. Please use only Line’s Bottle seal for each container.

5. The Cut-off time to gate in the export container (s) is as mentioned on this CRO. Containers arriving after cut off time will not be accepted until/unless otherwise written confirmation is received from us.

6. Stuffing of IMCO cargo with prior approval only. Containers to be affixed with IMCO labels on four sides prior returning to port. Any old labels have to be removed prior the Export container is sent to the Port.

7. Please check the empty containers prior release and accept only clean/sound units. Line will not accept any containers that are returned to port unused on account of damage. All related charges will be on the shippers account.

All bookings are subject to terms and conditions of carrier’s bill of lading.
